title: Horizon-specific Expert Fusion for Photovoltaic Power Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2609.15035v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Short-term photovoltaic power forecasting requires models to represent regular solar cycles and weather-driven fluctuations whose importance changes with the forecast horizon. This study develops a hierarchical ensemble that combines temporal neural models, historical analogs, state climatology, and gradient-boosted trees. Solar geometry and numerical weather forecasts describe the expected generation conditions, while horizon-specific convex weights combine complementary predictions. A separate calibration step uses available historical forecast errors to account for recent bias. The framework is evaluated on public PVDAQ data at 15--240-minute horizons and on three GEFCom2014 solar zones at hourly horizons up to four hours. translated_title: 面向光伏功率预测的预测时域特定专家融合方法
translated_abstract: 短期光伏功率预测要求模型能够表征规律性的太阳周期以及天气驱动的波动，而这些因素的重要性会随预测时域的变化而改变。本研究开发了一种分层集成方法，将时间神经网络模型、历史类比数据、状态气候学数据和梯度提升树相结合。太阳几何参数和数值天气预报用于描述预期的发电条件，同时采用针对预测时域特定的凸权重来融合互补的预测结果。此外，还通过一个独立的校准步骤利用可用的历史预测误差来修正近期偏差。该框架在公开的PVDAQ数据（15-240分钟预测时域）以及GEFCom2014三个太阳能区域数据（最长4小时的逐小时预测时域）上进行了评估。在PVDAQ数据上，该集成方法实现了4.315%的白天装机容量归一化平均绝对误差，在相同条件下相较于全特征LightGBM降低了4.11%的误差，相较于微调后的Chronos-2降低了6.03%的误差。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种基于预测时域特定凸权重的分层集成框架，融合时间神经网络、历史类比、气候学数据和梯度提升树等多种专家模型并结合偏差校准，在短期光伏功率预测中显著优于LightGBM和Chronos-2等强基线方法。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a horizon-specific hierarchical ensemble framework that fuses temporal neural models, historical analogs, climatology, and gradient-boosted trees with a bias calibration step, achieving superior short-term PV power forecasting performance that outperforms strong baselines such as LightGBM and Chronos-2.
